questions.q_en: A shopkeeper gives a discount of 10% on the purchase of 10 kg of lentils. the cost price of the lentils is Rs. 40/kg and the marked price is Rs. 45/kg. The weighing machine of the shopkeeper is faulty, and it shows weight of 1 kg when the actual weight is 900 grams. find the percentage profit of the shopkeeper(rounded off to two decimal places).
questions.solution_en:
Cost price of lentils = Rs. 40/kg

Marked price = Rs. 45/kg

Discount given = 10%

The faulty weighing machine shows 1 kg when the actual weight is 900 grams.

SP = MP * (1 - discount percentage) = 45 * (1 - 0.10)

=> Rs. 40.5/kg

Effective selling price for 900 grams of lentils is Rs. 40.5/kg which means the effective selling price per kg (1000 grams) will be :

Effective selling price = 40.5/0.90 = Rs. 45/kg

The profit per kg of lentils is the difference between the effective selling price and the cost price.

Profit/kg = 45 - 40 = Rs. 5/kg

Required profit percentage = 5/40 * 100 = 12.5%

questions.q_en: ? X 23 X 47 X 82 has unit's digit 6. Find the value that will replace "?".
questions.solution_en:
• 23 → 3; 47 → 7 → 3 X 7 = 21 → unit digit = 1

• 82 → 2 → 1 X 2 = 2

• Let the missing digit be d: 2 X d ≡ 6 (mod 10) → d = 3

questions.q_en: P and Q start running in opposite directions on a circular track from the same point. If their speeds are 10 m/s and 8 m/s, respectively, then after what time will they meet if the length of the track is 1620 m?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of P and Q = Speed of P + Speed of Q

Relative speed = 10 + 8 = 18 m/s

Time taken to meet = Length of the track / Relative speed

=> 1620 / 18 = 90 seconds

questions.q_en:
The non-terminating decimal among the following fractions is:

25/16, 29/4, 31/3, 41/5
questions.solution_en:
[If the denominator of a rational number has either 2 or 5 or both as prime factors, then the decimal expansion is terminating decimal]

25/16, factors of 16 is 2 * 2 * 2 * 2, so it is a terminating decimal.

29/4, factors of 4 is 2 * 2, so it is a terminating decimal.

31/3, factors of 3 is 3, so it is a non - terminating decimal.

41/5, factors of 5 is 5, so it is a terminating decimal.

questions.q_en: Angle bisector of ∠Q in ∆PQR is QS that meets PR at point S. If PQ = (x + 1) cm, QR = (2x - 1) cm, PS = (x - 2) cm and RS = (x + 2) cm, then find the length of side PR.
questions.solution_en:
PQ = x + 1

QR = 2x - 1

PS = x - 2

RS = x + 2

We know that: In the above figure, QS is the angle bisector, then- QP: PS = QR: RS

(x + 1): (x - 2) = (2x - 1): (x + 2)

(x + 1) (x + 2) = (x - 2) (2x - 1)

x2 + 3x + 2 = 2x2 - 5x + 2

x2 = 8x

x = 8

PR = PS + RS

= (x - 2) + (x + 2)

= 2x = 16 cm

questions.q_en:
The following pie chart shows the distribution (degree wise) of marbles in five jars.

Total number of marbles in all jars together = 4680

If 2/3rd of 25% of marbles from jar C are taken and put in jar E, then the difference between the total number of marbles in jar D and jar E becomes:
questions.solution_en:
Number of marbles in jar C = 4680 * 48/360 = 624

2/3rd of 25% of 624 = (2/3) * (1/4) * 624 = 104

Number of marbles in jar D = 4680 * 96/360 = 1248

Total number of marbles in jar E after putting marbles from jar C = (4680 * 72/360) + 104 = 936 + 104 = 1040

Required difference = 1248 - 1040 = 208.

questions.q_en: The price of petrol increases by 45 %, by what percentage should a bike owner reduce his petrol consumption to ensure that his expenditure on petrol does not increase? (correct up to two decimal places)
questions.solution_en:
Let the initial price of petrol per Liter and initial consumption of petrol be '100' and '100' respectively.

Initial expenditure = 100 x 100

The new price of petrol = 100 * 45/100 = 145

The final consumption of the petrol = 100 * 100/ 145

= 68.96

Hence, the required value = (100 - 68.96) * 100/100 = 31.03%

Relative speed = 34 + 66 = 100 km/h = 100 x 5/18 = 500/18 m/sec

Distance = 1240 m

Time = 1240/ (500/18) = 44.64 seconds = 45 seconds

questions.q_en: If A = (144)169 + (445)237 - (629)426, then what is the unit digit of A?
questions.solution_en:
Any power of 5 gives 5 as unit digit.

Even power of 4 gives 6 as unit digit and odd power of 4 gives 4 as unit digit.

Even power of 9 gives 1 as unit digit and odd power of 9 gives 9 as unit digit.

Therefore,

Unit digit of A = 4 + 5 - 1 = 9 - 1 = 8
